opening.argument: The video solicits ₹2,000 as the entry point to an online business while promising extraordinary returns: "You can earn lakhs or millions due to this." It presents the amount as an accessible investment, stating, "Anyone can invest so much on themselves on 2k." The promotion then directs viewers to contact the promoter to join: "Then by sending me the message. They can join our online business." Immediate action is reinforced by a visible ₹2000 note and the messages "Start Today" and "Don’t think so much," turning the earnings pitch into a direct recruitment appeal.
